articles.summary: Altria Group, Inc. (NYSE: MO) today announced that our Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.06 per share, payable on April 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of March 25, 2026. The ex-dividend date is March 25, 2026.
